{{Top|leg}}
A '''singer''' was one of the most important individuals among [[Kari]] society. Each [[Hatch]] had at least one singer, while larger Hatches contained many hundreds. Singers gather information and pass it on between individual Kari and whole Hatches. The best singers in Kari society were known as [[Bard (title)|bards]].
